subject: social
title: Needs and Wants
about: Needs (food, water, shelter, clothing) versus wants, scarcity, and making a choice when there is not enough. NC 1.E.1.1: scarcity and limited resources.
tip: At the store, let him sort three items into need or want and say why.

cards.q: What do we call something you must have to live?
cards.note: A need is something your body must have, like food and water.

cards.q: What do we call something nice to have that you can live without?
cards.note: Wants are fun to have. We just do not need them to live.
Clothing is a need too. It keeps your body warm and dry.

cards.q: Is water a need or a want?
cards.note: Every person must drink water to live.

cards.q: Is a toy a need or a want?
cards.note: Toys are fun, but you can live without them.

cards.q: Is a safe home a need or a want?
cards.note: A safe home is shelter. Shelter is a need.

cards.q: Is candy a need or a want?
cards.note: Candy is a treat. Your body does not need it to live.

cards.q: Is a warm coat in winter a need or a want?
cards.note: Clothing keeps your body warm and safe, so it is a need.

cards.q: Is a video game a need or a want?
cards.note: A video game is fun, but no one needs it to live.

cards.q: Is healthy food a need or a want?
cards.note: Your body needs healthy food to grow and have energy.

cards.q: Is a new bike a need or a want?
cards.note: A new bike is nice to have, but it is not needed to live.

cards.q: Is air to breathe a need or a want?
cards.note: Every person must breathe air to live.
A house, an apartment or a tent can all be shelter.

cards.q: What do we call it when there is not enough of something for everyone?
cards.note: Scarcity means there is not enough to go around.

cards.q: When you cannot have everything, what do you make?
cards.note: Making a choice means picking one thing and letting the other go.

cards.q: There is one cookie and two kids want it. Is the cookie scarce or plentiful?
cards.note: Scarce means there is not enough for everyone who wants it.

cards.q: You have money for one toy but want two. What do you do?
cards.note: When money is limited, you pick the one you want most.
